guidelines.detail: refines FID-01 (The description explicitly requires both contacting the providers and finding out their availability, prices, and delivery times. The reference models information-gathering as a distinct activity, while the generated model has no counterpart for it. This guideline makes the general instruction to model distinct stated activities more specific about this situation and their order.)

same as LRN-046 (The label pairs show generated gateway and task labels diverging from the reference, while the description distinguishes the relevant conditions, thresholds, and actions. LRN-046 already covers faithfully labeling BPMN elements with the stated action or decision and its criteria.)

refines SUB-05 (The description requires checking all sources and preparing orders related to them. The missing flows indicate that the generated model omitted the repetition decision and the transition from completing those checks to subsequent work. SUB-05 addresses explicit repetition, while this guideline adds how to model its continuation decision and completion.)

refines FID-03 (The description specifies distinct stock thresholds and actions, while the generated gateway and activity labels do not faithfully express those decisions and actions. The guideline refines FID-03 by making explicit that relevant conditions, scope, and distinctions should be preserved.)

refines GW-01 (The description states that insufficient supply from one shop leads to ordering from several shops, supporting a conditional sourcing decision; the missing exclusive gateway is consistent with that modeling difference. This makes GW-01's general guidance on controlling divergence more specific. The first-arrival difference is not used: the generated intermediate catch event represents the describe)

same as LRN-061 (The label pairs show gateways and activities associated with meanings that do not match their described conditions or actions. The description supplies distinct conditions and actions, while LRN-061 already states the same core labeling principle.)

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description says to contact multiple external providers and obtain specified information from them before using it to make a choice: Model obtaining that information as a distinct activity after the contact and before the choice.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description says to contact multiple external providers and obtain specified information from them before using it to make a choice

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description states an action or decision represented by a BPMN element, including any applicable scope or criteria: Label the element with concise wording that faithfully reflects the stated action or decision and preserves any applicable scope or criteria, without implying unsupported meaning or broader applicability.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states actions or decisions with specific criteria or distinctions that could be confused with related actions or decisions

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description requires checking or collecting information for every member of a set before acting on the set as a whole: Model the per-member work as an explicit repetition, use a decision to repeat while members remain, and route completion of the repetition to the collective follow-up activity.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description requires checking or collecting information for every member of a set before acting on the set as a whole

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description states an activity or decision with a particular action, condition, scope, or criterion: Label the corresponding BPMN activity or gateway concisely and faithfully, preserving distinctions relevant to the described action or decision rather than substituting unrelated meaning.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states an activity or decision with a particular action, condition, scope, or criterion

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description states that whether one provider can meet a requirement determines whether one or multiple providers are used: Model the alternatives with an exclusive gateway, and condition its outgoing flows on the stated requirement.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states that whether one provider can meet a requirement determines whether one or multiple providers are used
